about: Legitimate uses of Studio's avoid words in this repository's public docs, for egatari-studio tools/lint-terms.mjs --prose . --allow tools/terms-allow.components.json (run by tools/test-terms.mjs). Same form as Studio's docs/terms-allow.json.

allow.reason: 鍵盤 (the keyboard's keys): 「前のステップの鍵盤」 is not a step key (ステップの鍵 = step label).
The name of Natural Earth's dataset ne_10m_admin_0_countries_jpn (the Japan point-of-view edition of the data), not a software version; kept with standards' approval (2026-11-13).
A slide title the author might write (choose where to start), not the 再生 button; Studio's make-llm-guide.mjs PACK_EDITS quotes this README sentence verbatim, so changing it breaks Studio's gen.

allow.pattern: not a components manifest \(version, components, files\)
allow.reason: A CLI error for whoever builds the gallery: components is this repository's name (egatari/components) and a manifest field, not the word for a part.
A CLI error: the pack is the release tarball (or its unpacked folder), not the AI instruction pack.
